result.question: Why follow Abimelech?

readings.support: for they said, “He is our brother.”

readings.answer: Because he hired them with silver.
readings.support: with which Abimelech hired some worthless and reckless men to follow him.

readings.answer: Because his mother’s brothers spoke about him to the leaders.
readings.support: when his mother’s brothers spoke all these words about him in the presence of all the leaders of Shechem, their hearts were inclined to follow Abimelech

assessments.reason: Verse 9:3 explicitly states the leaders followed because “He is our brother,” which matches the key’s “He was their relative.”
Verse 9:4 says Abimelech hired men with silver to follow him, which is a valid reason for those followers even if the key targets the leaders’ kinship reason.

Verse 9:3 links the brothers’ speech to the leaders’ hearts being inclined to follow; while the text gives kinship as the stated rationale, attributing the inclination to the persuasive speech is a reasonable causal inference.
